venom_arm.note: fix_rate = fixed / (baseline wrong); harm_rate = harmed / (baseline right). A correct answer replaced by a refusal counts as HARM. The neutral-memory run is the control: same bank size, no matching keys, so the reflex must not fire.

neutral_memory_control.note: fix_rate = fixed / (baseline wrong); harm_rate = harmed / (baseline right). A correct answer replaced by a refusal counts as HARM. The neutral-memory run is the control: same bank size, no matching keys, so the reflex must not fire.

drift_check.rule: the neutral-memory control must not change the answers; if it does, the memory itself is causing drift

honesty: This is a small open model on mundane world-knowledge facts. A passing gate means the injection path is not actively harmful on this set - it does NOT mean the layer improves a real workload. The fix rate here is largely the model COPYING the injected context; that is a property of the benchmark, not a demonstration of knowledge repair.
